title: Train the speed-clock experiments natively: the learning-rate floor option and each experiment's gait clock reach native training and Spark packs
summary: Native training and Spark packs now carry two settings the surrogate attempts used. A learning_rate_min learner option (CLI --learning-rate-min) gives CappedRatePPO a floor above the stock schedule's 1e-5; ppo_config records it in the algorithm block and needs the rate ceiling. EXPERIMENT_CLOCKS names the speed-scaled gait clock of destination_v16 to destination_v24, so native training builds the destination wrapper with it and ppo_config records it as the wrapper's gait_clock_scaling; a test checks it agrees with each experiment's reward. The c48_long recipe lists the new option at None, which leaves its configuration unchanged.
next: Queue destination_v23 on the Spark from the v9 ghost_v11 start with a 2e-5 learning-rate floor.
reason: Optional learner settings and named-experiment plumbing; defaults, the canonical task and admitted recipes are unchanged.
